work.author: Aristotle
work.description: Aristotle's ethical treatise in ten books, conventionally addressed by book and chapter and more precisely by Bekker page, column, and line. Book VII distinguishes continence, incontinence, endurance, and softness and tests whether steadfastness follows right reason rather than mere attachment to an opinion.
